reasons: Wrong metric type selector: postgresql.index.scans is defined as a monotonic sum and the dataset only has sum, but the candidate selects otel_metric_type="gauge". It should be "sum".

Quantity differs: the Datadog query averages the raw index_scans value, which is a cumulative count, while the candidate wraps it in rate(...[$__rate_interval]), producing a per-second rate. The unit changes from scans to scans/s.

Template variables are dropped: $db (prefix db) and $host (prefix host) should become matchers on the db and host labels (e.g. postgresql_database_name=~"$db" and host_name=~"$host" per the observed dataset labels). The candidate omits both, so the series set differs. $scope has no prefix and $table is unused, so dropping them is correct.

Grouping label is unverified: postgresql_index_name is not among the observed dataset labels for this metric, so the by-clause may not match any dataset label. Dataset label names are authoritative, so it needs checking before it can be accepted.
